title: General.
officialText:
Every structure, room, or space hereafter altered or erected in which persons live, sleep or work, or in which
feed, food or foodstuffs are stored, prepared, processed, served or sold, shall be constructed in accordance with the pro visions of
this section. All metal or wire protection materials specified herein shall be noncorrosive.
